notes: Researcher-defined first version (docs/proposal/PariQuant.md, Sec. 4.3). No tolerance below has been chosen: numerical tolerances are set from the pilot partition only, then the table is frozen (status 'frozen', version bumped) before any held-out evaluation.
Which descriptors are 'required' is a proposal pending agreement with the supervisors; supplementary descriptors never enter the overall decision.

Native operation counts of different gate families are not comparable by default: a cross-technology comparison of these descriptors needs a stated justification in 'applicability' before the role is 'required' for such pairs.

rules.name: occupied_physical_qubits
rules.definition: Number of distinct physical qubits (including ancillas) that carry at least one operation or measurement in the compiled program; unused wires of a full-device representation are not counted.

rules.name: native_two_qubit_operations
rules.definition: Count of native two-qubit operations in the submitted native program (CZ, RZZ, RXX/MS, ZZ ...), including operations attributable to routing.
rules.applicability: Within a technology. Across technologies only with a justified interaction-equivalence descriptor (e.g. canonical nonlocal content); not assumed.

rules.name: native_one_qubit_operations
rules.definition: Count of native one-qubit operations in the submitted native program.

rules.name: routing_attributed_two_qubit_operations
rules.definition: Subset of native_two_qubit_operations attributed to routing/transport (attribution only, never charged twice).
rules.applicability: Where routing is observable in the compiled program.

rules.name: scheduled_duration
rules.definition: Scheduled circuit duration from the provider/compiler schedule, where exposed.
rules.applicability: Only where a schedule or operation durations are observable; otherwise 'insufficient'.

rules.name: requested_shots
rules.definition: Requested sampling budget per circuit (an experiment setting; see pariquant.shots).
rules.applicability: All; held equal by design unless varied as a controlled resource.

rules.name: calibration_context_fields
rules.definition: Provider-reported calibration/characterization fields (T1/T2, gate and readout errors, durations). Execution context only.
rules.applicability: Only like-for-like fields of equal scope and characterization method; static or literature values are never matched against measured ones.
